    SELECT "raceId"
    FROM "races"
    WHERE "year" = 2009
    ORDER BY "round" DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
mc AS (
    SELECT "constructorId"
    FROM "constructors"
    WHERE "name" = 'McLaren'
)
SELECT cs."position"
FROM "constructorStandings" cs
JOIN last_race lr ON cs."raceId" = lr."raceId"
JOIN mc ON cs."constructorId" = mc."constructorId";

SELECT cs.position
FROM constructorStandings cs
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE c.name = 'McLaren'
  AND r.year = 2009
ORDER BY r.raceId DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT cs.position AS position
FROM constructorStandings cs
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE c.name = 'McLaren'
  AND r.year = 2009
  AND cs.raceId = (SELECT MAX(raceId) FROM races WHERE year = 2009);

FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors AS c ON q.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE c.name = 'McLaren' AND r.year = 2009
ORDER BY r.round;

WITH season_races AS (
        SELECT raceId
        FROM races
        WHERE year = 2019

    qual_avg AS (
        SELECT d.driverId,
               AVG(q.position) AS avg_qual_pos
        FROM drivers d
        JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
        JOIN season_races sr ON q.raceId = sr.raceId
        GROUP BY d.driverId
    ),
    race_avg AS (
        SELECT d.driverId,
               AVG(r.position) AS avg_finish_pos
        FROM drivers d
        JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
        JOIN season_races sr ON r.raceId = sr.raceId
        WHERE r.position IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY d.driverId
    )
SELECT 
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver,
    qa.avg_qual_pos,
    ra.avg_finish_pos,
    (qa.avg_qual_pos - ra.avg_finish_pos) AS diff
FROM drivers d
JOIN qual_avg qa ON d.driverId = qa.driverId
JOIN race_avg ra ON d.driverId = ra.driverId
ORDER BY diff DESC;

        SELECT q.driverId,
               AVG(q.position) AS avg_qual_pos
        FROM qualifying q
        JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
        WHERE r.year = 2019
        GROUP BY q.driverId
    ),
    fin AS (
        SELECT res.driverId,
               AVG(res.position) AS avg_fin_pos
        FROM results res
        JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
        WHERE r.year = 2019
        GROUP BY res.driverId
    ),
    driver_stats AS (
        SELECT d.driverId,
               d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
               COALESCE(q.avg_qual_pos, 0) AS avg_qual_pos,
               COALESCE(f.avg_fin_pos, 0) AS avg_fin_pos,
               COALESCE(q.avg_qual_pos, 0) - COALESCE(f.avg_fin_pos, 0) AS diff
        FROM drivers d
        LEFT JOIN qual q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
        LEFT JOIN fin f ON d.driverId = f.driverId
        WHERE q.driverId IS NOT NULL OR f.driverId IS NOT NULL
    )

       avg_fin_pos,
       diff,

),
cumulative AS (

           SUM(points) OVER (PARTITION BY driverId ORDER BY date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_points
    FROM driver_points

       MAX(c.cum_points) AS highest_total_score
FROM brit_drivers bd

    WHERE nationality = 'British'

WITH race_pts AS (

           c.name AS constructor_name,
           cr.points
    FROM races r

    JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
    WHERE r.year = 2009
      AND c.name IN ('McLaren', 'Ferrari')

    rp.round,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rp.constructor_name = 'McLaren' THEN rp.points END) AS mclaren_points,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rp.constructor_name = 'Ferrari' THEN rp.points END) AS ferrari_points,
    CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rp.constructor_name = 'McLaren' THEN rp.points END) > 
              MAX(CASE WHEN rp.constructor_name = 'Ferrari' THEN rp.points END) 
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mclaren_exceeds_ferrari
FROM race_pts rp
GROUP BY rp.round
ORDER BY rp.round;

    FROM "constructorResults" cr
    JOIN filtered_races fr ON cr.raceId = fr.raceId
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT cp.raceId, cp.constructorId,
           SUM(cp.points) OVER (PARTITION BY cp.constructorId ORDER BY fr.date
                                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_points
    FROM constructor_points cp
    JOIN filtered_races fr ON cp.raceId = fr.raceId

    SELECT c.raceId, c.cum_points AS mc_points

    JOIN "constructors" con ON c.constructorId = con.constructorId
    WHERE con.name = 'McLaren'

fer AS (
    SELECT c.raceId, c.cum_points AS fer_points
    FROM cumulative c
    JOIN "constructors" con ON c.constructorId = con.constructorId
    WHERE con.name = 'Ferrari'
)

       fer.fer_points AS "ferrari_points",

FROM mc

JOIN filtered_races fr ON mc.raceId = fr.raceId

JOIN races ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId

    SELECT 
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        r.grid,
        ra.name AS race_name,
        c.country,

    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    JOIN circuits c ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId

WITH max_points AS (
    SELECT MAX(points) AS max_pts FROM results
), best AS (
    SELECT driverId, raceId, points
    FROM results
    WHERE points = (SELECT max_pts FROM max_points)
)
SELECT d.dob,
       b.points AS driver_points,
       (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results WHERE raceId = b.raceId) AS average_points
FROM best b
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = b.driverId;

WITH max_points AS (
    SELECT MAX(points) as max_pts
    FROM results
),
max_driver_race AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, r.raceId, r.points
    FROM results r
    CROSS JOIN max_points mp
    WHERE r.points = mp.max_pts
),
avg_by_race AS (
    SELECT raceId, AVG(points) as avg_points
    FROM results
    GROUP BY raceId
)
SELECT 
    d.dob,
    md.points,
    a.avg_points
FROM max_driver_race md
JOIN drivers d ON md.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN avg_by_race a ON md.raceId = a.raceId

WITH driver_best AS (
    SELECT driverId, raceId, points AS best_points,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY driverId ORDER BY points DESC, raceId) AS rn
    FROM results
),
best_driver AS (
    SELECT driverId, raceId, best_points
    FROM driver_best
    WHERE rn = 1
    ORDER BY best_points DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.dob AS date,
       bd.best_points AS driver_points,
       (SELECT AVG(r.points) FROM results r WHERE r.raceId = bd.raceId) AS avg_points
FROM best_driver bd
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = bd.driverId;

WITH max_points AS (
        SELECT MAX(points) AS max_pts
        FROM results
    ),
    top_results AS (
        SELECT raceId, driverId, points
        FROM results, max_points
        WHERE points = max_pts
    ),
    avg_per_race AS (
        SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_points
        FROM results
        GROUP BY raceId
    )
SELECT races.date,
       top_results.points AS driver_points,
       avg_per_race.avg_points
FROM top_results
JOIN races ON top_results.raceId = races.raceId
JOIN avg_per_race ON top_results.raceId = avg_per_race.raceId;

SELECT r.date,
       res.points AS driver_points,
       (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results WHERE raceId = res.raceId) AS avg_race_points,
       res.points - (SELECT AVG(points) FROM results WHERE raceId = res.raceId) AS difference_from_average
FROM results res
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE res.points = (SELECT MAX(points) FROM results)
LIMIT 1

top_driver AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.points FROM results r JOIN max_points m ON r.points = m.max_pts),
race_avg AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(points) AS avg_pts FROM results GROUP BY raceId)
SELECT ra.date AS race_date, td.points - ravg.avg_pts AS points_vs_average
FROM top_driver td
